question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘India After Gandhi: The History of the World's Largest Democracy’?
solution:
The correct answer is **Ramchandra Guha**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramchandra Guha** is a well-known Indian historian and writer.
 
• The book **'India After Gandhi: The History of the World's Largest Democracy'** was published in 2007.
 
• It covers the history of India from the time of independence in 1947 to the early 2000s.
 
• The book provides a detailed account of India's political, social, and economic changes post-independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Ramchandra Guha** is not only a historian but also a biographer and cricket writer. He has written several books on various subjects, including environmentalism, politics, and cricket.

The book **'India After Gandhi'** has been praised for its extensive research and balanced perspective on India's post-independence history.

**Ramchandra Guha** has received several awards for his contributions to literature and history, including the Padma Bhushan in 2009.

His works are known for their detailed analysis and engaging writing style, making complex historical events accessible to a broad audience.
